articles.summary: We sat down with the founder of the Center for the Impossible, Professor Jeffrey J. Kripal, one of the leading scholars of extraordinary human experiences and the host of the show, along with executive producers Harris Fishman and Chris Muckle (October Films) to give viewers a sense of what to expect when this special new series premieres on October 1 on AMC+ and Sundance TV.

articles.summary: FearFest may be coming to a close at the end of October, but that doesn’t mean the spine-tingling fun has to end. Once Halloween has come and gone, head over to Shudder to get your year-round horror fix, starting with Season of Screams, an annual celebration dedicated to expanding spooky seasonal the way through December.
